Guidance: Principles governing how change requests are evaluated, prioritized, and approved.
Conditions and variance thresholds that necessitate formal change control submissions.
Software tools and tracking mechanisms used to log and trace change requests.
Criteria for low-impact changes manageable within existing project tolerances.
Criteria for significant changes affecting baselines, budgets, or critical path.
Expedited protocols for urgent operational or security change interventions.
Designated members, roles, and voting authority within the Change Control Board.
Frequency of CCB meetings and quorum requirements for binding change approvals.
Rules governing threshold-based escalation to executive sponsors or steering committees.
Standard operating procedure for logging and submitting formal change requests.
Cross-functional analysis evaluating scope, schedule, cost, quality, and risk impact.
Formal sign-off steps and procedures for updating affected baselines and plans.
Process for communicating change decisions and tracking implementation progress.
